documents.title: CAL FIRE S2T Airtanker
documents.access_note: Names the Marsh conversion, TPE331-14GR engines, 29,150 lb gross weight, 1,200-gallon payload, speed, range, and endurance.

documents.title: Ground Pattern Performance of the CDF S-2T Turbo Tracker Airtanker
documents.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Missoula Technology and Development Center
documents.access_note: Cup-grid tests of the CDF Marsh S-2T constant-flow system; exact fleet/system lineage, but current tail-level continuity is unverified.

documents.title: NWCG Standards for Airtanker Operations, PMS 514
documents.access_note: Defines minimum multi-engine drop height, airtanker typing, supervision, spacing, landing-loaded policy, and environmental downloading.

documents.title: PMS 514 Appendix E: S-2 Tactical Flight Procedures
documents.access_note: Current S-2 formation, sequencing, communications, and tactical procedures; not an aircraft performance manual.

documents.title: CAL FIRE C-130 Hercules
documents.access_note: Identifies ex-USCG HC-130H airframes, 4,000-gallon RDS, 155,000 lb gross weight, T56-A-15 engines, range, and endurance.

documents.title: AFMAN 11-2C-130H Volume 3 Addendum B, MAFFS
documents.access_note: Applicable to C-130H/J with the 3,000-gallon MAFFS installation. It is not applicable to CAL FIRE's 4,000-gallon RDS.

documents.title: AFMAN 11-2C-130H Volume 3 Addendum A
documents.access_note: Public weight-and-balance rules and nominal fuel-burn planning for military C-130H; exact CAL FIRE RDS operating weight and supplements remain absent.

documents.title: CAL FIRE HAWK
documents.access_note: Current CAL FIRE build, internal/external gross weights, tank capacity, max cruise, endurance, roles, and builder.

documents.title: Sikorsky S-70 FIREHAWK Helicopter
documents.access_note: States 1,000-gallon tank, refill under 45 seconds, 155-knot dash speed, and operational roles; no hover or payload charts.

documents.title: Sikorsky Expands iFly Performance Calculator to S-70i Operators
documents.access_note: Confirms an operator calculator accounts for Firehawk tank drag and installed options; calculator data are not public.

documents.title: CAL FIRE UH-1H Super Huey
documents.access_note: Identifies the modified UH-1H, derated T53-L-703 engine, gross weight, tank/bucket capacity, cruise, range, and endurance.

documents.title: USDA Forest Service Aircraft Inspector Guide
documents.access_note: Documents multiple UH-1H -703 STCs and configuration effects; warns military charts do not account for the airframe/engine combination.

documents.title: TM 55-1520-210-10, UH-1H/V Operator's Manual
documents.access_note: Performance charts are for the T53-L-13 UH-1H/V, not CAL FIRE's modified -703 Super Huey.

documents.title: CAL FIRE King Air 200
documents.access_note: Nominal platform and intelligence role only.

documents.title: CAL FIRE OV-10 Air Tactical Aircraft
documents.access_note: Nominal platform and aerial-supervision role only.

documents.title: Interagency Fire UAS Ordering
documents.access_note: Defines current operational UAS ordering around sensing, mapping, aerial ignition, and staffed Type 1 support.

documents.title: Skydio X10 Technical Specifications
documents.access_note: Nominal aircraft, environmental, endurance, and sensor limits; no incident-cycle validation.

documents.title: ANAFI USA Technical Specifications
documents.access_note: Nominal aircraft, environmental, endurance, and sensor limits; no incident-cycle validation.

documents.title: Alta X Specifications
documents.access_note: Nominal aircraft and payload/endurance examples; aerial-ignition integration and incident cycle remain configuration-specific.
